artworks.title: Campagna Scene with Artist Sketching
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape with various elements throughout. There is a seated figure on a rug near architectural ruins and a tree. Animals such as cows and goats are seen in the distance. Additionally, a few people are walking along a path. The black and white color palette and detailed etching style enhance the scene.

artworks.title: Saints on Clouds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a group of individuals wearing religious garments, including miters. They are shown from the waist up in various seated or standing positions. Their expressions are diverse, suggesting discussion or contemplation. The individuals' heads are mostly covered, and they wear elaborate robes. Some hold objects like books or staffs. In the background, lighter figures are seated on clouds, creating a celestial setting.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century, Follower of Pier Francesco Mazzucchelli, called Morazzone
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gazing upwards at a central figure seated on clouds. The figures below appear to be in motion, gathered closely, some with arms extended towards the hovering central figure. The central figure is depicted in a relaxed, seated posture, arms extended outward, surrounded by clouds. This is in the style of an artist from the Renaissance period, featuring draped clothing on the figures, which creates a sense of movement and dynamism in the composition. The use of soft shading and delicate lines emphasizes the ethereal quality of the scene. The entirety of the image is done in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Bust of Two Men [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with light underdrawing with a stylus on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 7.2 x 13.3 cm (2 13/16 x 5 1/4 in.)
support: 15.3 x 21.4 cm (6 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals in profile. The person on the left has curly hair partially covered by a hat, with layered patterned clothing. They have a prominent nose and detailed eyes and lips. The person on the right has less hair and wears similar layered clothing, with a high forehead and pointed nose. In the background, there is an incomplete sketch of an eye above the second person. The detailed line work and shading stand out against a plain background.

artworks.title: Standing Young Man [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
support: 12.3 x 6.3 cm (4 13/16 x 2 1/2 in.)
support: 21.4 x 15.3 cm (8 7/16 x 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a full-body sketch of a human figure in a dynamic stance. The person's face has simple features, and the hair is loosely drawn. The clothing is indicated with minimal detail. There are no objects or accessories, and the background is a textured surface with signs of wear and aging.

artworks.title: Fisherman in a River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brush and brown ink
artworks.description: The image features a landscape scene viewed from a slightly elevated vantage point. The horizon is high in the image, with a light sky subtly textured by brushstrokes. The focus is a densely wooded area with various trees, their branches extending into the distance. The loose brushstrokes for the trees convey a sense of foliage. The color palette is various shades of brown, giving a sepia-toned appearance. Beyond the trees, there are figures, a boat, and birds. The balance between detailed and suggestive brushwork creates a serene and timeless atmosphere.

artworks.title: Reclining Woman
artworks.medium: red crayon (on Japan paper?)

artworks.title: View of the Castle Sant'Angelo and the Ospedale di Santo Spirito [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a cityscape with detailed buildings and a river. Prominent structures include a circular tower on the right and a pavilion on the left. The drawing features precise lines, capturing the texture of the stone and the flow of the river. The color palette is sepia-toned. Closest to the viewer, dynamic lines represent water movement, with small figures and a floating barrel adding scale to the scene.

artworks.title: View of the Tiber; Copy of a Roman Sculpture of a Bacchante [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person lying on their side. The person is facing forward with their head turned slightly to the side, resting on their arm. Their facial features are delicately sketched, and their hair is wavy. The individual is wearing flowing, draped garments with floral patterns. There are decorative elements or jewelry on their wrist and in their hair, and they hold a cluster of leaves or flowers. The background is a light sketch of an architectural cityscape.

artworks.title: Mercury and Argus
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray-brown wash on laid paper squared with brown ink
artworks.description: The picture shows an illustration of a scene with various figures and animals in a landscape where the horizon is not visible. The drawing is done from a slightly elevated angle, showing a view of the setting. The scene depicts figures, trees, animals, and foliage, all interconnected. The illustration uses bold outlines and light shading to create depth and movement. The color scheme is mainly brown, gray, and black on a faded tan background, giving it an aged look.

artworks.title: Bridge over an Estuary
artworks.medium: charcoal and pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an artwork showing a waterway with a bridge. Various ships and cranes are visible against a muted sky. The brushstrokes are subtle and sketch-like, giving texture to the slopes and structures. The color palette is mainly grays, blacks, and sepia. In the foreground, a bank slopes down to the water, leading to the bridge spanning the water. In the distance, docked ships and masts are visible.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Galatea
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, heightened with white, over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological creatures and celestial beings. The illustration depicts a collection of cherubic figures with wings in the sky and mythical aquatic creatures in the sea. A central figure appears to be reclining on a large shell, while surrounding this figure are other fantastical beings in dynamic poses. The scene is rich with details of mythical creatures, such as a person with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a sea creature, and a vessel pulled by fanciful sea animals.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of a Goat to Jupiter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ritualistic scene with figures and a sacrificial animal. The drawing features three figures participating in a ceremonial or sacrificial act. One figure kneels beside a horned animal, holding its horns. Flames rise from an altar in the background, suggesting a sacrificial offering. Another figure stands by the altar, gesturing upwards with one hand. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and shading, capturing the garments and poses of the participants.

artworks.title: Study of a Standing Woman
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with white heightening on brown washed paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual has a solemn expression, delicate features, medium-length hair, and is wrapped in flowing cloth. Their hands are visible holding the fabric close to their chest. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain, accentuating the figure and detailing of the drapery. The artwork is presented on a light-colored mount contrasting with the sepia-toned drawing.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. The first figure is standing and leaning slightly forward, gripping the arm of the second figure, who is seated against a tree with their arms bound above their head. The standing figure has short, curly hair and defined facial features, wearing a draped garment and sandals. The second figure is mostly nude, with wavy hair and a beard, bound to a tree. A stringed musical instrument, resembling a viola, is at the feet of the seated figure. The background features trees, hilly formations, and structures in the distance, all in muted, sepia tones.

artworks.title: Female Roman Statue Seen from the Back
artworks.medium: pen and brush with brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a draped figure seen from behind. The image depicts a figure covered in a flowing, intricately folded garment, showcasing the detailed rendering of fabric folds and texture. The figure appears to be holding part of the drapery up with one hand, revealing a partial view of the back and arm. The overall composition is contained within a rectangular frame, and there is a soft finesse in the representation of hair and posture.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of Saint Mark [recto and verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in robes engaged in an interaction. An ethereal figure or deity hovers above them, surrounded by clouds and cherubs. The composition captures movement and emotion through the gestures of the figures and the lines of clouds. The facial expressions and postures of the figures suggest a narrative. The use of line and shading adds depth and texture to the scene, enhancing the theme.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: black chalk on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central figure is depicted on the middle cross with outstretched arms and a tilted head, flanked by two additional figures on separate crosses. Below them, a group of individuals is seen in varying postures. The use of chiaroscuro with soft pencil strokes captures a dramatic scene. The hazy, unfinished quality gives it a sense of immediacy and movement. The composition is balanced with the central figure as the focal point and surrounding figures adding depth and context.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Reading in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on brown laid paper (laid down on early blue paper album sheet)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of an older man from the waist up, kneeling on the ground. He is leaning on a rock, with arms extended towards a book in front of him. He has a long beard, prominent nose, and shoulder-length curly hair. His upper body is bare, revealing a strong physique. There is a lion resting with its head down at the man's feet. The background features a rocky terrain with sparse vegetation, including trees with arched branches and leaves.

artworks.title: The Mystic Marriage of Saint Catherine?
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts an assembly of figures in flowing poses. Six figures are visible, with the central figure seated and facing forward, featuring a simple face with minimal details. The figure's head is surrounded by a rounded form resembling a headscarf or halo. Other figures stand and lean around the central figure, dressed in flowing robes. Two figures appear to be children. The background is abstract with free-flowing lines, framing the central group. The sketch is monochromatic, using pen strokes to create the figures.

artworks.title: Historical Scene
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene filled with figures, horses, and elaborate details. The setting appears theatrical, with drapery, ornate architectural elements, and a mass of people concentrated in the center. The drawing portrays varied dramatic poses, shields, spears, and a winged figure atop an architectural feature. The composition suggests movement and turmoil. The monochromatic tones and fine details contribute to a sense of depth and grandeur.

artworks.title: The Flood
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash, heightened with white, over charcoal on brown prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring numerous nude figures engaged in various activities amidst dynamic natural elements. On the left side, figures cling to a gnarled tree with objects around them. In the center, figures row a small boat. To the right, there is a structure resembling an ark with figures nearby, while others move forward on rocky terrain. Clouds and light rays above add drama to the composition. The drawing depicts a scene of struggle and unity against a natural setting.

artworks.title: The Ford (Le passage du gué)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring a scene with fine lines. The horizon is high, with trees dominating the center. The linework provides texture to the trees, foliage, and figures. The color palette is monochrome, with varying line density creating contrast and shading. In the foreground, goats are near water, and two figures stand in conversation. Another figure is seated. Trees frame the middle distance, with birds in the sky.

artworks.title: Cow, Bull and Calf
artworks.medium: etching
